description: FREE. Run this before paying any x402 (HTTP 402) service. Pass the service URL and the PAYMENT-REQUIRED value it sent you (or price_usd and pay_to). Returns GO / CAUTION / STOP with reasons: is the service working, is the price fair (vs its public listing, what our monitor saw, and similar services), is the wallet it asks you to pay safe and the one it normally uses?

max_price_usd.description: Optional: STOP when the price is above this

pay_to.description: Wallet you're asked to pay, if you don't pass payment_required

payment_required.description: The PAYMENT-REQUIRED header value the service sent (base64), or its decoded JSON / 402 body

price_usd.description: Price asked, if you don't pass payment_required

url.description: The service you're about to pay (optional when payment_required names it)

name: preflight_x402_payment
title: Pay Safe: check before paying an x402 service (free)
